independence: No producer/sampler imports or calls; scalar FP64 coordinate loops and scalar finiteavailable q8 prompt loops. Sources read first and compared to adapter outputs.
limits: Raw96 pixels copied from original saved caches and matched byte-for-byte; no fullRGB re-decoding or re-sampling performed.
Frame and prior JSON projected onto explicit input-only fields immediately; no annotation/reference/score fields used.
Validgrid checked for all constructed crops; nonconstructed rows retain original zero placeholders rather than inventing crops.
FullRGB source/decoded hashes checked as metadata correspondence only; fullRGB bytes were not opened or hashed.
No SAM/head outputs, weights, classifier forward, fitting, reference/annotation evaluation or semantic label audit.
